title: Repository Truth Recovery
objective: Reconcile repository identity, status, Git reality and historical authority before permanent Development Engine automation expands.

tasks.description: Inventory and classify authoritative, normative, generated and stale repository truth sources.
Reconcile project identity, version and current-status drift without rewriting historical evidence.
Map current Git, PR and certification reality into the permanent-state design.
Define explicit protection boundaries for frozen historical evidence.
Produce and validate the canonical baseline consumed by ENG-01.

done_when: all current truth sources are classified by authority
identity and status drift has a bounded remediation plan
Lot44 Lot45 and Lot46 reality is represented without ambiguity
historical evidence protection boundary is explicit
ENG-01 has one canonical baseline to consume
